title: Category Memory · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Category Memory · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner names four items from the same broad category. The lead names the four items in any order. All four items match the original list without extras. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Category Memory, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All four items match the original list without extras.
recall.why: All four items match the original list without extras.
